newsitem.title: USA: Morgan Stanley business units set records.
newsitem.headline: Morgan Stanley business units set records.

text.p: Morgan Stanley Group Inc said Tuesday its three main businesses -- investment banking, sales and trading and asset management -- saw record revenues in the fourth quarter and in fiscal 1996.
Investment banking revenues of $572 million in the fourth quarter surpassed the $542 million record set in second quarter 1996, the company said.
Investment banking revenues for the full year were $1.944 billion, up 34 percent from the annualized fiscal 1995 figure.
The company said sales and trading revenues for the quarter were $729 million, up 37 percent from the year-ago figure.
Sales and trading revenues for the full year were $3.156 billion, up 32 percent from the annualized 1995 figure.
Morgan Stanley said revenues from its asset management business were $180 million for the quarter, a 90 percent increase over the year-ago figure.
Full-year revenues from the business were $582 million, up 56 percent from the annualized 1995 figure, the company said.
